args.body: Thank you for your email. First, a correction: our email of 17 Feb said no issues were found, but the inspection report (attached to that email) does record two points. (1) A dog flap has been fitted in the back door/utility room. (2) Sticker-type marks from command strips on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window, which the tenant is to remove and make good. Everything else was rated good. We are sorry for the confusion. On the dog flap, we are checking with the tenant whether any permission was given and will tell you what they say. On the spare front door key and the lock change, we are asking the tenant when and why the lock was changed and who holds keys, and will come back to you. As the name on your email differs from the landlord name we hold, please confirm you are the landlord or acting for them. You will hear from us by 22 Feb.
